caption:
Güney Amerika ormanlarının sürü halinde avlanan küçük avcısı çalı köpeği, sadece 5-8 kilo olmasına rağmen kendinden en az 21 kat ağır bir tapiri bile devirebiliyor. 🐕🌿

en.title: This Small Dog Takes Down Giant Prey. Name It?
en.description: This is the bush dog of South America. It weighs only 5 to 8 kg, yet a pack of six was reported hunting a tapir at least 21 times heavier than one dog. Its toes are partially webbed, helping it swim.
